note: Offline gates of the free-space corridor planner v1 (perception: haltere.vision.free_space on the depth process; pilot: haltere.liftoff.corridor_aim in FastRaceCue; docs/free_space_planner.md). Thresholds are the judged specification's section 9 values, fixed before any held-out frame of the planner is scored. Each gate is scored once and every version is reported. Offline replays are open loop and are not flight evidence. The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256; a change needs a new version and a new freeze.

free_space_config.note: frozen separately (perception side) with its own sha256 before any held-out scoring; the gates below score that version only

dev_report_only.note: the union of both designs' development data (ScaledCorridor and RSCP-2D); numbers on it are reported, never gated, except where a gate below is marked dev-flagged

scoring.publication: offline samples are published at capture + offline_age_s (the live gap-sample age p50 was 96 ms)
scoring.confirmation: the real haltere.liftoff.corridor_aim.CorridorAim (and VerticalGuard) with the frozen free_space.json pilot/vertical values
scoring.clock: distances and times use the confirming sample's capture time
scoring.hindsight: the M2 failure anatomy (obstacle coordinates, impacts) and telemetry are used for scoring only, never as an input
scoring.decode_note: decoded with gap_cue_eval extract (CPU), then relative depth in one GPU chunk

S1.what: floor scale: h_floor / telemetry height over the flat garage floor
S1.approaches_note: the five held-out Minus Two approaches to pillar A flown without gap-cue authority (the gap-on and wall flights changed their paths; reported, not gated)

S2.what: pillar range: planner range / true range over pillar-A blocks (projected pillar box covering >= 50% of the block) at 3-8 m

S3.what: coverage: valid planner samples on frames with speed > 2 m/s and the ring in view

A1.what: pillar A: confirmed LEFT (the ring side) early, never RIGHT far out, never an applied aim inside the pillar
A1.pass_rule: first confirmed class L (or confirmed blocked with the L option urgent) at distance >= min(6.0 m, d_switch - 0.5 m), d_switch = distance to the pillar face when the pillar-A ring enters the cue
A1.no_applied_aim_inside: no applied aim ray inside the pillar's azimuth extent (box inflated by pillar_a_inflate_m) while the ring ray is outside it
A1.report: the pillar_sim clearance for both response models (brain08, fast_pd)

B1.what: pillar B (dev-flagged because of the graft, gated anyway): a confirmed shift away from the pillar (-x) at least 1.0 s before impact

T1.what: Pine trunk: first confirmed RIGHT early enough for brain-08 to move 0.5 m sideways
T1.lead_note: brain-08's 0.55 s delay plus 0.39 s to move 0.5 m sideways at 6.5 m/s^2
T1.report: the first raw R sample and the brain-08 kinematic clearance; the gap cue scored 0.66 s

Q1.what: clean Straw Bale laps: few, small, quiet episodes
Q1.episode: intended offset != 0 or confirmed blocked; gaps < 0.3 s merged
Q1.report: the floor-bound activation rate and the per-environment rates of the four report-only store environments

L1.what: leaks: the G4 perturbation set (ring painted or removed on every 10th frame; masks recomputed; LK pair taken from the unperturbed previous frame)
L1.hud_only: disparity 10 on HUD pixels and 1 elsewhere: 0 frames blocked or shifted

V1.what: ceiling: no climb into the garage ceiling (pilot_replay --stack on --planner on with the perception plan stream)
V1.window: from before_onset_s before the last logged governor climb onset before the impact to the ceiling impact
V1.no_v_class_into_ceiling: no confirmed class-V aim whose corridor (intended el over d_h, plus r_vert_m) reaches the sample's h_ceil

V2.what: floor sink: slowed and stopped, never a hard climb from a flat floor
V2.flat_rule: requested vz <= max_vz_flat whenever the telemetry height >= floor_clear_m and rise is not confirmed
V2.low_rule: requested vz >= 0 whenever the telemetry height < floor_clear_m while descending (measured vz < -descending_mps)
V2.displaced_rule: the governor climb is displaced on >= displaced_fraction of the ticks where it was active in the log

V3.what: Pine mound (dev-flagged, no-regression): climb or side-step while the logged governor climbed; no late descent

R1.what: runtime and parity: G8 protocol, straw-brain08-06 30-90 s replayed with Liftoff idle, one GPU chunk

I1.what: identity: planner off and shadow are bitwise identical (FastRaceCue section 6) and label isolation passes

consequences.S1-S3: no authority flights, only shadow flights
consequences.A1 or V1-V2: no authority flights on Minus Two
consequences.T1: no authority flights on Pine Valley
consequences.Q1: v2 adds RSCP's expansion veto under a new version and a new freeze
consequences.deviation: any flight with authority after a gate failure is a deviation: it needs the user's explicit go-ahead in chat and is reported as a deviation
